# AI-Academy

> Interactive training on the EU AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 as amended by
> Regulation (EU) 2026/1744) with a language-model tutor. Runs entirely locally.
> The learning content is in German; code and documentation are English.
> Intended purpose and limits: docs/INTENDED-PURPOSE.md.

## Read first
- [README](README.md): what it is, how to start it
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): binding working rules — principles, layout, conventions
- [docs/INTENDED-PURPOSE.md](docs/INTENDED-PURPOSE.md): intended purpose, excluded uses

## Structure
- [content/SCHEMA.md](content/SCHEMA.md): content schema, mandatory fields
- [DESIGN-SYSTEM.md](DESIGN-SYSTEM.md): design reference — colour, type, motion
- [TESTING.md](TESTING.md): test levels, commands, what counts as evidence

## Operation and maintenance
- [SETUP-AGENT.md](SETUP-AGENT.md): setup contract with a machine-checkable acceptance list
- [TROUBLESHOOT-AGENT.md](TROUBLESHOOT-AGENT.md): procedure when something breaks
- [UPDATE-PROZESS.md](UPDATE-PROZESS.md): procedure for legal changes — binding

## Assessment and risk
- [docs/REVIEW-PROCESS.md](docs/REVIEW-PROCESS.md): how the content was reviewed, including the limits of the procedure
- [docs/CUT-SCORE-BLUEPRINT.md](docs/CUT-SCORE-BLUEPRINT.md): derivation of the pass mark
- [docs/CRITICAL-ERRORS.md](docs/CRITICAL-ERRORS.md): errors that fail an exam regardless of score
- [docs/RISIKOREGISTER.md](docs/RISIKOREGISTER.md): deliberately accepted risks
- [docs/THREAT-MODEL.md](docs/THREAT-MODEL.md): threat model of the bridge
- [docs/DATENSCHUTZ-ROLLENMATRIX.md](docs/DATENSCHUTZ-ROLLENMATRIX.md): data-protection roles per operating mode

## Contributing
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): rules, stricter for content than for code
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): how to report a vulnerability
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): changes, legal baseline listed separately

## Fundamentals
The code has no runtime dependencies. The language model is an explainer and
grader **on the basis of supplied sources — never a legal source itself**. Access
runs exclusively through the sign-in of the respective command-line tool; API keys
are ruled out.
